listing.name: Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G (optional FUComplete mod) — Poke (francl35)
listing.original_game_title: Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G (optional FUComplete mod)
listing.summary: This is a work in progress rather than a general release. The project reports village, quest, combat and zone tests, with remaining edge cases and interpreter fallback for some code. Standalone overlay generation is not yet a confirmed documented procedure, and macOS hydration is incomplete. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G disc and decrypted EBOOT.ELF. European and USA Freedom Unite are unsupported. This guide does not specify the exact Japanese serial number, revision, hash or FUComplete mod version; check the project’s profile before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate the main C++ code from your own decrypted EBOOT.ELF and build locally with CMake, SDL3 and Vulkan. Overlay libraries are separate. These instructions do not establish a precompiled player release.

warnings: This is a work in progress rather than a general release. The project reports village, quest, combat and zone tests, with remaining edge cases and interpreter fallback for some code. Standalone overlay generation is not yet a confirmed documented procedure, and macOS hydration is incomplete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
